row.body: The school aid list pairs a bandage with a note to keep the test-room door shut; the last line asks who will collect the used kit.
row.title: Aid for the school

sidecar.gloss: A school aid record links a closed room to an unclaimed used kit.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could have isolated an aid room after exposure from many causes; the list does not identify the hazard.
